cohort: 75 IUCD users attending the outpatient department of gynecology at Mahatma Gandhi Medical College, Puducherry, over a 3-year period between 2017 and 2019, of whom 28 presented with missing IUCD threads.
finding: Of the 28 patients with missing IUCD threads, 2 had spontaneous expulsion, 6 continued use after confirming normal placement, and 20 opted for retrieval, most commonly due to the desire for conception (60%).
